Looking at the table:

- Rick Adelman: United States
- John Amaechi: England
- Louis Amundson: United States
- J J Anderson: United States
- Shandon Anderson: United States
- Rafael Araújo: Brazil
- Carlos Arroyo: Puerto Rico
- Isaac Austin: United States
- Anthony Avent: United States

Now, count by nationality:

- United States: 6 players (Adelman, Amundson, J J Anderson, Shandon Anderson, Austin, Avent)
- England: 1 player (Amaechi)
- Brazil: 1 player (Araújo)

So, United States has 6 players, England has 1. England did not contribute the most players; the United States did.
